subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Credit Freezes and Fraud Alerts
description: A quick win: understand Credit Freezes and Fraud Alerts.

hook.text: A credit freeze stops anyone from opening new accounts in your name — including you.

buildup.text: You can freeze your credit at all three bureaus for free. It takes about ten minutes.

discovery.text: A fraud alert is lighter — it tells lenders to verify identity before opening accounts.

twist.text: Most people don't freeze their credit until after they've been victimized — when it's too late.

climax.text: A proactive freeze is the single most effective defense against new-account identity theft.

punchline.text: Freeze your credit before someone else uses it.

quiz.question: What does a credit freeze do?
options: It prevents anyone from opening new accounts in your name
